powerSources.name: Explorer 300 v2
powerSources.notes: Jackery rates 4,000 cycles to 70% capacity (not 80%). Enough for a CPAP without humidifier for several nights, too small for a stationary oxygen concentrator. The older Explorer 300 (293 Wh, lithium-ion) is a different model.

sources.title: Jackery Explorer 300 v2 product page (description and specs: 288Wh, 300W/600W surge, cycle life)

powerSources.name: Explorer 1000 Plus
powerSources.notes: Jackery rates 4,000 cycles to 70%+ capacity. Expandable with add-on battery packs.

sources.title: Jackery Explorer 1000 Plus product page (specs: 1264Wh, 2000W rated / 4000W surge peak, cycle life)

powerSources.name: Explorer 2000 Plus
powerSources.notes: Jackery's page limits appliances to 3000 W and says it powers heavy-duty devices up to 6000 W (peak); about 4,000 cycles to 70% capacity. Expandable with battery packs.

sources.title: Jackery Explorer 2000 Plus product page (refurbished listing): 2042Wh, LiFePO4, 'not exceeding 3000W', 'up to 6000W', cycle FAQ

powerSources.name: Yeti 1500X
powerSources.notes: Lithium-ion NMC rated 500 cycles to 80% (1C, full cycles, 25°C): fine for occasional outages, less so for daily cycling.

sources.title: Goal Zero Yeti 1500X product page, tech specs (battery capacity, cell chemistry, lifecycles, AC inverter)

powerSources.name: 12 V 100 Ah LiFePO4 battery + inverter
powerSources.notes: 12.8 V x 100 Ah = 1280 Wh, nearly all usable. Use a pure sine wave inverter sized for the largest load, fuse the battery cable, and allow 10-15% inverter loss; inverter size here is a typical example.

powerSources.name: 12 V 100 Ah AGM deep-cycle battery + inverter
powerSources.notes: Only about half (≈600 Wh) is usable without shortening battery life, and less at high loads or in the cold. Use a true deep-cycle battery; ResMed warns car starting batteries should not be discharged more than about 30%.

sources.title: ResMed Battery guide (198103/4 2015-08), 'Types of batteries' (automotive vs deep-cycle discharge limits)

powerSources.name: Back-UPS Pro 1500 (BR1500MS2)
powerSources.notes: Rated 1500 VA / 900 W. Spec listings give 228-257 VAh of sealed lead-acid battery (lower figure used); not confirmed on APC's site. UPS units bridge minutes, not nights, and their own electronics use power, so small loads run shorter than the battery size suggests.
